description: This file defines the LeaveRequestModel class, which serves as a data model for leave requests within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It uses traits for serialization and normalization, and maps entity data to API schema properties.

classes.name: LeaveRequestModel
classes.description: A model class representing a leave request for API serialization and deserialization, mapping an underlying LeaveRequest entity to a structured API schema.
